title: Trump's Narrative Lost Ground When Independent Style Standards Declared the Conflict a War
description_short: Trump's Narrative Lost Ground When Independent Style Standards Declared the Conflict a War
description_medium: AP's explanation showed how language itself became a battleground: Trump's communications sought controlled scope, while newsroom standards responded to observable escalation facts. Once major outlets lock in war terminology, public baseline expectations shift fast. Trump's narrative leverage decreased as the lexical frame hardened against him.

proposed_correction: Quote the AP style guidance and date, identify the terminology used by the administration and AP, and substantiate any claimed effect on public understanding before completing the long description.
